scope: Real WMF M4A playback and audio mixer, AI held stationary to isolate music lifecycle; no fixed simulation clock
passed_cases: Real M4A is ready, duration matches metadata, playback remains stopped before countdown
Music does not start during the three-second countdown
Gameplay starts the media and audio mixer, HUD remaining time follows media position
Pause freezes both song position and game timer, then resumes them
Non-zero decoded audio confirmed; play the entire song to its natural end
Actual media end produces a time-limit loss and closes the player
Retry prepares a fresh media player at zero with the full song duration
Retry starts the song from the beginning; apply lethal contact damage
Health loss stops the song immediately
Second retry prepares another fresh round
Arrange the final enemy defeat on the actual media-end event
The last defeat wins a tied music deadline, stops playback and stays stable
